title: The Wrong Trousers
summary: A title sequence under sixty seconds, made in a team. Credits for a chase on a model railway, where the type lays its own track one frame ahead of the train.
role: Direction and editing, in a team of three
coverAlt: Film still of letters laid like railway track in front of a toy train

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: Laying track in front of a moving train is already a typographic problem. Every letter has to arrive just in time. We made the credits the track.

blocks.label: Storyboard. The hand-drawn frames, with timing notes for each credit.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: We shot the train on a tabletop layout and built the type in After Effects to match the camera. My part was direction and the edit. I cut the sequence to the rhythm of the wheels, so each name lands on a beat.

blocks.caption: From the first track test to the final frame.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: Working as three meant agreeing on timing early. Next time we would lock the music before shooting, not after.
